description.value:
You've practiced casting powers even in the chaos of battle.

You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration on a power when you take damage.

Once per round, when a hostile creature's movement would provoke an opportunity attack from you, you can use your reaction to cast a power at it instead of making that attack, provided the power has a casting time of 1 action and targets only that creature.

system.requirements: 4th level, ability to cast force or tech powers.
